draw_circle_segment: draw a circle segment on a numpy image array given origin, radius, heading, and theta angle
calculate_angles: calculate a numpy array of angles in radians from a reference point for every pixel in an image
angular_distance_from_angle: compute the normalized angular distance from a given angle at each pixel relative to a reference point
fill_convex_hull: fill the convex hull of non-zero pixels in a binary image and return the filled mask
run_spot_utils: run the spot utils module to draw and display a circle segment on a sample image
